incidentContext.operatorReport: Oroboros reconciled a 48-hour accumulation of abandoned task trees.

repositoryActuals.claim: Twelve retained .claude worktrees contained 15,232 directories and represented 92 percent of the checkout walk.
The daemon log woke its own watcher and caused a persistent full-reconcile feedback loop.
Kotlin compiler session churn fired a full reconcile per transition until .kotlin became an excluded segment.
